title: Seven Operators of Dimensional Echoes
description: Canonical RTT schema defining the seven universal operators and their expressions across the 3D–9D dimensional ladder.

dimension.description: Dimensional rung within the resonance-time ladder.

operator.description: Universal operator active within this dimensional echo.

echoTheme.description: The thematic resonance of the dimension (Container, Cycles, Harmonics, Coupling, Regimes, Lineage, Supsphere).

rttEquation.description: Canonical RTT symbolic expression for the operator at this dimension.

expressionMode.description: How the operator manifests (generate, shape, animate, transform, persist, contain, align).

coherenceField.description: The coherence domain or envelope governing the operator’s stability.

relations.description: Other operators or dimensions this operator interacts with.
